setup.heading: Set a passphrase
setup.intro: Your data is encrypted with this passphrase. Forget it and there is no recovery — there is no cloud and no reset.

timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.noEntries: No entries yet. Click "New entry" to start.

llm.title: AI models (Ollama)
llm.intro: AI features run entirely on your machine through Ollama. Pull the models below and they will be used to extract entities and build the graph in the background.
llm.ollamaDown: Ollama not reachable. Install from ollama.com, then start it. The app will retry automatically.

graph.title: Graph
graph.empty: No entities yet — write a few entries and the graph will populate as they are processed.

nav.hypothesesHint: AI-noticed patterns the engine wants you to discuss with a clinician

safety.banner: This software helps you organise patient-reported context. It is NOT a diagnosis. Discuss findings with a licensed clinician.

hypotheses.heading: AI-noticed patterns
hypotheses.corroborateHint: Mark this entry as 'doctor agreed it matters'
hypotheses.confirmedBadgeTooltip: You've confirmed this disease before — citations are weighted higher next time the engine runs.
hypotheses.disclaimerHeading: These are pattern observations, not diagnoses.
hypotheses.disclaimerBody: The engine compares your journal against curated profiles of common and rare conditions. Each card cites the entries and lab values that contributed. Bring the cited journal entries to a clinician — they decide whether further evaluation is warranted.
hypotheses.empty: No patterns to show yet. Add a few entries (or load a demo patient from the Timeline) and re-check.

insights.heading: Clinician brief
insights.pdfHint: If WeasyPrint isn't installed, you'll get an HTML download you can browser-print to PDF.
insights.disclaimer: This brief is patient-reported context for clinical evaluation. Every assertion in it cites the underlying journal entry. It is not a diagnosis.

pair.intro: Scan the QR with a phone on the same WiFi. The phone will land on a focused capture page that posts photos straight into the journal. Locking the journal invalidates every paired phone.
pair.label: Label
pair.lanWarning: We couldn't find a LAN IP — the QR resolves to the local machine only. Use phone hotspot or USB tethering.
pair.lockNote: When you lock the journal, every paired phone loses write access immediately.

pair.heading: Pairing this phone
pair.failed: Pairing failed. Ask the desktop to generate a new QR.
pair.ownerLocked: The desktop journal is locked. Ask the owner to unlock and try again.

capture.heading: Diary capture
capture.ownerLocked: Owner locked the journal — drafts are queued
capture.tapShutter: Tap the shutter to take a photo
capture.notePlaceholder: Optional note — what is happening right now?
capture.privacyNote: Photos are encrypted as soon as they reach the desktop. Nothing leaves your home network.

qr.intro: Have the clinician scan this code while their phone is on the same WiFi as this computer. The link is read-only and expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
qr.lanWarning: We couldn't find a LAN IP — the QR resolves to the local machine only. The clinician's phone will need to share this device's network (USB tethering or hotspot).
qr.noteLocked: When you lock the journal the share link stops working immediately.

bundle.exportIntro: Download a single `.diary` file containing the entire encrypted journal — database, media, salt. Anyone with the file still needs your passphrase to read it.
bundle.importIntro: Already have a `.diary` file from another machine? Pick it here and enter the passphrase it was exported with. Imports are only allowed into a brand-new install.
bundle.importPassphrase: Passphrase used when the bundle was exported
bundle.errorWrongPassphrase: That passphrase doesn't open this bundle.
bundle.errorBadBundle: That file isn't a valid Symptom Diary bundle.

ask.heading: Ask about your journal
ask.intro: Pose a question grounded in what you've written. Each answer cites the journal entries it draws on. Stateless — every question runs against a fresh read of your data.
ask.placeholder: e.g. What patterns do you notice across my last month of entries?
exampleList: What patterns do you notice in my recent entries?
How often did I mention headaches last month?
What did I write about coffee triggers?
Summarise my last two weeks for a clinician.
ask.fallbackBadge: Deterministic fallback — local AI was unavailable or returned unsafe text
ask.errorGeneric: Could not produce an answer. Try again.

demo.tooltip: Replace journal contents with a curated synthetic patient for demo or evaluation
demo.heading: Curated synthetic patients
demo.warnOverwrite: Selecting a persona will replace your current entries.

ollama.step3Detail: Use the panels below once Ollama is running.
ollama.daemonRunningExternal: Daemon already running (started outside the app)
ollama.daemonStopped: Binary installed but daemon is not responding on localhost:11434
ollama.spawnUnreachable: Spawned, but didn't bind a listener — check the OS logs.
ollama.noMethods: No automated install path on this platform.

documents.heading: Medical documents
documents.empty: No documents yet. Attach a visit note or lab from any entry to populate this view.
documents.disclaimer: AI extracted these fields from a photo of the document. Verify before treating any value as authoritative — this is not a diagnosis.

labs.heading: Lab timeline
labs.empty: No lab values recorded yet. Attach a lab result document to populate this view.
labs.pickPrompt: Pick a test on the left to see its history.

medications.heading: Medications
medications.empty: No medications recorded yet. Attach a prescription or visit note to populate this view.
